summary.en: BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual entry in Evaluation Analysis
summary.zh: BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）评测与分析年度条目

description.en:
BenchCouncil lists PolyCoder in the Evaluation Analysis area of its AI100 (2022-2023) annual table. It associates the work with the publication “A Systematic Evaluation of Large Language Models of Code”. The page names Frank F. Xu, Vincent J. Hellendoorn as the main contributors.

This Archive record preserves the official row order, citation value, institution, and country fields. It represents the annual 2022-2023 selection and remains separate from the long-term canonical AI100 storyline.
description.zh:
BenchCouncil 在 AI100（2022-2023）年度表的“评测与分析”领域列出 PolyCoder。该条目关联论文《A Systematic Evaluation of Large Language Models of Code》。页面把 Frank F. Xu（官方页拼写）、Vincent J. Hellendoorn（官方页拼写） 列为主要人物。

本 Archive 记录保留官方行序、引用数、机构和国家字段。它表示 2022-2023 年度入选记录，与长期 canonical AI100 故事线分开维护。
